title: Renoprotective effect of diosmin against chlorpyrifos-induced kidney injury is mediated by the regulation of TLR4/HMGB1/NF-kappaB, PPAR-gamma/SIRT1, and Bax/Bcl2 signals.
authors: Althumairy, Duaa; Ismail, Mohammad Bani; Zahra, Hamad Abu; Alghamdi, Badrah S; Althagafy, Hanan S; Omar, Zainab Mohammed Mahmoud; Hassanein, Emad H M; Ali, Fares E M
one_liner_zh: 该文研究地奥司明对毒死蜱致肾损伤的保护作用，涉及TLR4/NF-kB等信号通路，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，仅分子对接为辅助验证，与本课题无关。
abstract: Chlorpyrifos, an organophosphorus pesticide commonly used in agriculture, has been associated with nephrotoxicity and other harmful effects. This study investigates the renoprotective effects of diosmin, a flavonoid known for its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, against chlorpyrifos-induced kidney damage in rats. Male Wistar albino rats were exposed to chlorpyrifos at a dose of 10 mg/kg for 28 days, and the protective role of diosmin at a dose of 50 mg/kg, orally, was assessed through various biochemical, histopathological, molecular, and computational analyses. Chlorpyrifos exposure significantly induced kidney damage by elevation of kidney functions and NGAL, as well as histopathological alteration. In addition, chlorpyrifos exposure induced renal inflammation as evidenced by upregulation of TLR4, HMGB1, p-NF-kappaB, TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, and MPO levels. Besides, chlorpyrifos induced oxidative stress as evidenced by decreasing PPAR-gamma, SIRT1, GSH, and SOD expressions associated with increased MDA levels. Furthermore, chlorpyrifos induced renal cell apoptosis, as proved by Bax and Bcl2 dysregulation. Interestingly, co-administration of diosmin with chlorpyrifos ameliorated these effects, restoring kidney function biomarkers, preserving histological structure, suppressing inflammatory burden, reducing oxidative stress parameters, and inhibiting apoptosis. In addition, the results of molecular docking confirmed the in vivo results. Taken together, diosmin exerts a renoprotective effect by attenuating chlorpyrifos-induced oxidative stress and inflammation, highlighting its potential as a therapeutic agent for mitigating pesticide-induced kidney injury.
abstract_zh: 毒死蜱（chlorpyrifos）是一种农业中常用的有机磷农药，与肾毒性及其他有害效应相关。本研究探讨了地奥司明（diosmin）——一种以其抗氧化和抗炎特性著称的黄酮类化合物——对大鼠毒死蜱诱导的肾脏损伤的保护作用。雄性Wistar白化大鼠以10 mg/kg剂量暴露于毒死蜱28天，并通过各种生化、组织病理学、分子及计算分析评估了地奥司明以50 mg/kg剂量口服给药时的保护作用。毒死蜱暴露显著诱导肾脏损伤，表现为肾功能指标和NGAL升高，以及组织病理学改变。此外，毒死蜱暴露诱导肾脏炎症，证据为TLR4、HMGB1、p-NF-kappaB、TNF-alpha、IL-1beta和MPO水平上调。同时，毒死蜱诱导氧化应激，证据为PPAR-gamma、SIRT1、GSH和SOD表达降低，并伴随MDA水平升高。进一步地，毒死蜱诱导肾细胞凋亡，由Bax和Bcl2失调所证实。有趣的是，地奥司明与毒死蜱联合给药改善了这些效应，恢复了肾功能生物标志物，保持了组织学结构，抑制了炎症负担，减少了氧化应激参数，并抑制了凋亡。此外，分子对接结果证实了体内实验结果。综合来看，地奥司明通过减轻毒死蜱诱导的氧化应激和炎症发挥肾脏保护作用，凸显其作为缓解农药诱导肾脏损伤治疗剂的潜力。
